findings.label: Green difficulty badges
findings.description: lib/constants.ts line 28 maps Beginner difficulty to bg-green-100 text-green-700. Replace with orange equivalents: bg-orange-100 text-orange-700.

findings.label: Logo filename with spaces
findings.description: The Circuit Learning logo path uses spaces in the filename. Next.js Image handles this, but if the path is copied or used in raw HTML elsewhere, it will break. Rename to logicemb-circuit-learning-full.png and update all references.

findings.label: No build verification note
findings.description: The review instructions specified checking d:\side-agency\web-dev\logicemb\.agents\tasks\build-note.md for build success, but this file doesn't exist. The commit message claims the build passed, but there's no independent verification.

findings.label: Contrast ratio below WCAG AA
findings.description: #FF6B00 on white is approximately 3.0:1, below the 4.5:1 minimum for normal text. Small orange text on white backgrounds will fail accessibility checks. Use #CC5500 or darker for text, or ensure orange is only used on dark backgrounds or for large UI elements.
